mechanismOfAction.summary: Presumed LSD prodrug via boronate ester hydrolysis → 5-HT2A partial agonist; boron toxicology completely unstudied.
mechanismOfAction.description: First boron-containing LSD prodrug (distinct from 1B-LSD which is 1-butanoyl-LSD). Boronate ester hydrolysis rate unknown; potency vs LSD empirically uncharacterized (mass-ratio claims of ≈100 µg LSD-equivalents are unvalidated). Emerged Dec 2025 as successor to banned 1S-LSD. Boron-specific toxicological profile is entirely unstudied.
